checks.detail: no recorded accident within 2.0 km dated 2024-02-10 to 2025-04-03; no record in the window within the context radius. Coverage is limited: Outside the United States the absence of a record is weak evidence: most general-aviation and all military crashes abroad are in neither catalogue.
checks.source: NTSB aviation accident database (data.ntsb.gov/avdata) and Wikidata aviation-accident items

evidence.coverage: NTSB aviation database (avall, 2008 to the download date): civil aviation accidents and selected incidents in the United States, its territories and international waters, plus foreign events involving US-registered, US-operated or US-manufactured aircraft in which the NTSB took part. It holds no military losses and almost no other foreign accidents, and records without coordinates cannot be matched. Wikidata: only accidents notable enough to have an item with coordinates within 10 km; far from complete anywhere. Outside the United States the absence of a record is weak evidence: most general-aviation and all military crashes abroad are in neither catalogue.

evidence.coverage: Meteorite Landings table (Meteoritical Society / NASA open data, as mirrored for TidyTuesday 2019-06-11): about 38,000 located meteorites, mostly finds; the year is the fall or find year, coordinates are often rounded to an arc-minute or worse, masses are recovered masses, and the table stops in the early 2010s. Later falls are only covered by Wikidata meteorite items, which the wikidata_nearby check evaluates.

persistent artificial light at the site (human activity): Persistent artificial light IS present within 1500 m of the candidate: peak radiance 9.66 against background 4.2 nW/cm2/sr, lit in 3 of 3 monthly composites (202504 to 202506, 17 cloud-free nights). This indicates ongoing human activity or combustion at or near the site; it does not say what the feature is. Before the onset (202309 to 202402) persistent light was already present (radiance 10.16, background 2.455 nW/cm2/sr). Sensor footprint about 750 m, so a neighbour within roughly 1 km cannot be separated. Archive ends 2025-06-30.
checks.source: World Bank Light Every Night archive, VIIRS DNB monthly cloud-free composites (globalnightlight.s3.amazonaws.com/composites)
